<!-- Source page: LXD -->

LXD (Linux Container Hypervisor) offers a REST API to manage containers. LXD configuration is supported via [NixOS options](https://search.nixos.org/options/?query=lxd)

As of NixOS 25.11, LXD has been removed from nixpkgs[^1]. You can use <a href="incus" class="wikilink" title="incus">incus</a> instead.
